_comment: Per-client governance baseline template. Copy to the client project root as 'governance-baseline.json' and fill in real values. GLMPS reads this file from the project root (or from config.governanceBaseline if you want a non-default path). Do NOT commit this example file as an active baseline — it would fire drift alerts on every machine that lacks these exact files.
client: Acme Corp (optional label — appears in report exports)

requiredFiles.label: Claude Code project policy
requiredFiles._note: sha256 is optional. When present a content-hash mismatch triggers a 'guardrail-modified' critical. Omit to check presence only.

requiredFiles.label: Cross-tool agent policy
requiredFiles._note: No sha256 here — presence check only.

requiredHooks.label: Live-install write guard (Claude Code PreToolUse)
requiredHooks._note: GLMPS checks that settingsFile exists and contains the 'match' string. If either is false the hook is considered missing.

_coveredTools_note: List every AI tool the client uses. Any tool with live GLMPS sessions NOT in this list fires a 'tool-uncovered' warning — the 'what if they switch AI vendor' detector.
